global_rules.spacing: Dense and compact. p-1, p-2 for table cells. No wasted space.
global_rules.accessibility: Ensure high contrast. Include data-testid on all interactive elements.
global_rules.typography_rules: Avoid Inter/Roboto for headings. Use IBM Plex Sans for UI and IBM Plex Mono for tables.

layout.app_container: h-screen w-screen flex flex-col overflow-hidden bg-white
layout.header: h-14 border-b border-gray-200 flex items-center justify-between px-4 bg-gray-50 flex-shrink-0
layout.bottom_tab_bar: h-10 border-t border-gray-300 bg-gray-100 flex items-center flex-shrink-0 overflow-x-auto px-2

upload_zone.wrapper: border-2 border-dashed border-gray-300 rounded-lg p-12 flex flex-col items-center justify-center bg-gray-50 hover:bg-gray-100 transition-colors mx-4 my-8 cursor-pointer

data_table.th: px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-gray-700 uppercase tracking-wider border-r border-gray-300 last:border-r-0 whitespace-nowrap
data_table.td: px-3 py-1.5 text-sm whitespace-nowrap border-r border-gray-200 last:border-r-0 font-mono tabular-nums

bottom_tabs.tab_button_active: h-full px-4 border-t-2 border-primary bg-white text-primary font-medium text-sm flex items-center shadow-sm -mt-[1px]
bottom_tabs.tab_button_inactive: h-full px-4 border-t-2 border-transparent bg-gray-100 text-gray-600 hover:bg-gray-200 text-sm flex items-center transition-colors

controls.search_input: h-8 text-sm border border-gray-300 rounded focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary focus:border-primary px-3
controls.export_button: h-8 px-3 bg-primary text-white text-sm rounded hover:bg-primary_hover flex items-center gap-2 transition-colors font-medium shadow-sm

interactions.hover: Subtle background shifts on rows (e.g., bg-blue-50) to help track long lines of data visually.
interactions.focus: High contrast ring (ring-2 ring-primary ring-offset-1) on all inputs and buttons.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement a full-screen application layout (100vh) without page scrolling; scrolling should only happen inside the table container.
Use react-dropzone for the Excel upload feature in the center of the screen when no data is loaded.
The table MUST use virtualization (e.g. @tanstack/react-virtual or react-window) because 20,000 rows will crash standard DOM rendering.
Headers of the table must be sticky (top-0).
Bottom tabs should mimic Excel behavior: fixed at the bottom, switching the active view/dataset.
Numeric data columns must use tabular-nums (font-variant-numeric) or a monospace font like IBM Plex Mono to align perfectly.
Highlight specific rows programmatically: 'Total' rows, 'Spare' (+5%) rows, and 'Inclineur' rows with distinct subtle background colors.
Include export functionality (Excel/CSV) via a prominent button in the header toolbar.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='upload-dropzone', data-testid='tab-summary', data-testid='export-button').
All text and labels must be in French as requested.
Use lucide-react for UI icons (upload, download, search, etc.).
